items.title: Restaurant Unresponsive (Food Not Ready)
items.condition: DP at restaurant, food not ready, MX not answering
items.details:
• Check if the DP is at the restaurant and try connecting with MX through the DP.
• If delay >40 mins, food still not ready, and both DP & MX are unresponsive → Proceed with Cancellation.
• If DP responds and confirms food is being prepared → Compensate the customer and explain the delay reason.
• If food is ready → Provide compensation based on delay duration.
• If delay >40 mins and food not ready, MX UR, but DP confirms he is on the way to pickup → Set status: Arrival at Restaurant, time as confirmed by DP.
Note: In food not ready case — call MX. If MX unresponsive, it is mandatory to check with DP for reason of delay. Ask DP to pass call to MX.

items.title: No DP Available in Area
items.condition: Less/moderate/high DP availability status
items.details:
• Check the Delivery Partner's availability status (less / moderate / high) and create a prompt for the bot.
• Prompt example: Due to less availability of the delivery partners, it is taking longer than usual to assign a partner.
• In case valet not assigned, if delay >25–30 mins → Send prompt for waiting.
• Cancel if delay is >30 mins.

items.title: Valet Not Assigned Case
items.condition: DP not assigned, food not ready, MX unresponsive
items.details:
• If DP is not assigned and food not ready → Call MX.
• If MX unresponsive → Set expected time: 10 mins → Order status: "Prep End" (only for less than 30 mins case).
• Call MX → MX unresponsive → food not ready → 10 mins time → prep end (from 17-Apr-26 update).

items.title: Restaurant Device Issues
items.condition: Restaurant can't see or process the order
items.details:
• Send prompt and select cancellation.
• Prompt example: Upon checking, the restaurant informed that they are facing device issues due to which they are unable to process your order.

items.title: DP Device Issues
items.condition: DP can't see order details on their device
items.details:
• Try to reassign first.
• If driver not available → Cancel.
• Prompt example: The delivery partner is facing device issues due to which he is unable to see your order at the moment.

items.title: Out of Stock / Missing Items
items.condition: Restaurant confirms items unavailable or partial
items.details:
1. If MX confirms items are partially missing (some items in the order are missing) → Escalate to agent.
   Example: If a customer ordered two items and only one can be prepared, the case must be escalated.

2. If COD order → Select cancellation.
   If prepaid order → Check with the restaurant partner if an alternate item can be prepared.
   • If NO → Cancel.
   • If YES (alternate item can be prepared) → Escalate to agent.

Note: If DP stated that the item is out of stock, agent must confirm this from MX.
• If restaurant unresponsive → Select cancellation.
• If MX said CX denied to accept alternate of the order → Select Cancellation.

items.title: Marked Ready Early (by Mistake)
items.condition: Restaurant marked order ready prematurely
items.details:
• Ask the restaurant to prepare the order on priority and ask how much time it will take.
• Create a prompt and mention the delay reason.
• Prompt example: The restaurant has marked the order ready before time by mistake but we have asked them to speed up the process for you.

items.title: Outlet Closed
items.condition: Restaurant confirmed closed or unresponsive
items.details:
• If confirmed (with restaurant) → Select cancellation.
• If restaurant is unresponsive → Go with the DP VOC and select cancellation.

items.title: Wrong Restaurant Address
items.condition: Restaurant address is incorrect or mismatched
items.details:
• If confirmed (with restaurant) → Select cancellation.
• If restaurant is unresponsive → Go with the DP VOC and select cancellation.

items.title: Mall Orders
items.condition: Order falls inside a mall / restricted premises
items.details:
• Call the restaurant. If they don't respond, call the Delivery Partner.
• Ask the DP for the estimation and create a prompt. Compensate according to the delay.
• Prompt example: Since the order falls inside a mall's premises, the delivery partner is not allowed to enter the gate. Trying our best to expedite the order for you.
• In case DP is waiting outside the mall, food is ready but DP is waiting outside → Set status: Prep End, expected time: 5 mins (from 17-Apr-26: Mall order food waiting = Expected 5 mins).

items.title: Awaiting Pickup — Order Picked but Status Not Updated
items.condition: Restaurant says order picked, status still shows Awaiting Pickup
items.details:
Scenario 1: Restaurant confirms order already picked up but status shows "Awaiting Pickup":
• If less than 30 minutes → Send wait prompt.
• If more than 30 minutes → Escalate the case.

Scenario 2: Both DP & MX unresponsive (Status: Awaiting Pickup):
• If delay >30 mins → Reassign the order.
• If no rider available for reassignment → Escalate the case.

Scenario 3: Delay >37 mins, status still "Waiting for Pickup", DP en route to restaurant:
• Contact both DP and MX. Reassign the order to another available DP.

Scenario 4: DP & MX unresponsive but DP was just assigned a few minutes ago:
• Call the DP. If still unresponsive → Mention in PN: "DP recently assigned by backend and is on the way to the restaurant; hence escalated" (only if delay >30 mins).

Case 1 – DP denies delivery (vehicle / accident / rain):
• Try to reassign. If DP unavailable → Cancel the order (applies pre & post pickup; time does not matter).
• Note: In rain, another DP can pick if available.

Case 2 – DP says no longer working with Zomato:
• Try to reassign. If DP unavailable → Escalate the case.

Case 3 – Mismatch in DP & MX response (Delay >30 mins):
• DP: Food not ready / MX: Food is ready → Reconnect with DP and confirm order is ready for pickup.

Case 4 – DP says "just reached the restaurant":
• Expected time: 2–3 minutes. Order status: Arrived at restaurant.

Case 5 – Delay <30 mins, DP & MX unresponsive, food ready & DP waiting at restaurant:
• Set order status: Preparation End. Set expected time: 5–10 minutes.

Case 6 – DP cannot see order on device:
• Ask DP to refresh the app. If still not visible → Reassign. If fails → Cancel.

If MX unresponsive and DP unsure about prep time and delay reason:
• If delay >40 mins → Escalate the case.

Scenario: DP & MX both unresponsive, delay <30 mins:
• Set order status: Preparation End. Expected time: up to 5 mins.
• Note: Do not add expected time less or more than 5 mins.

Scenario: Delay >30 mins, DP says caught by police (Status: Awaiting Pickup):
• First reassign. If no DP available → Escalate.

Scenario: DP confirms will reach restaurant and gives time (e.g., 20 mins):
• Give waiting prompt. Compensate as per delay.

items.title: Picked by Another DP
items.condition: Current DP says another DP already picked the order
items.details:
If the current DP says another delivery partner has already picked up the order:
• Call MX and confirm if the order can be prepared again.
• If MX confirms YES (can prepare again) → Provide waiting prompt. Compensate as per delay.
• If MX confirms NO (cannot prepare again) → Cancel the order.
• Cancellation Prompt: The order was picked up by a different delivery partner, which caused a delay. Unfortunately, the restaurant is unable to prepare it again, so the order has been cancelled.
• If MX is unresponsive → Check with the DP for confirmation.

items.title: DP Not Responding to Calls
items.condition: Post-pickup, DP unreachable but order in transit
items.details:
• Track the DP's location from the map and see if he is moving. Include double tracking details in PN.
• Prompt: The delivery partner is not responding to our calls at the moment but we can track his movement and he is getting closer to your location.
• Compensate according to the delay. Mention delay time and tracking details in private notes (PN).

If DP is not moving (order is Picked Up):
• If delay <30 mins → Ask customer to wait.
• If delay >30 mins → Escalate.

In DP UR case: Time doesn't matter — if KMs are not reducing, escalate above 30 mins delay.

items.title: DP Unable to Deliver After Pickup
items.condition: DP says cannot deliver — vehicle, mobile, or app issue
items.details:
• DP says order is picked up but unable to deliver (reasons: vehicle issue, mobile issue, app issue, etc.).
• Check with reassignment first.
• If reassignment not happening → Proceed with cancellation.

items.title: DP Unable to Find Customer Location
items.condition: DP struggling to locate delivery address
items.details:
• Ask the DP to call the customer and get a real-time update.
• Prompt: The delivery partner is facing difficulty to locate your location as per the map. He should be reaching you anytime now. You can also try calling him.
• If the DP needs assistance → Escalate the case to an agent.

items.title: Traffic / Festive Delay
items.condition: DP delayed due to traffic or festive conditions
items.details:
Case 1 – If order can be delivered:
• Prompt: Due to a festive occasion, the delivery partner is taking longer than usual to reach your location.
• Compensate according to the delay.

Case 2 – If the order cannot be delivered:
• Prompt: Due to a festive occasion, the delivery partner is taking longer than usual and is unable to move.
• Select cancellation.

items.title: Post-Pickup Order Transfer — Old DP Unresponsive
items.condition: New DP assigned but old DP unresponsive / unavailable
items.details:
Prompt: The primary delivery partner is not responding due to which the new assigned partner is unable to collect the order. Select cancellation.

Case 1 – New DP says no old DP available, number is switched off:
• Agent must attempt call from his/her end. If old DP number is switched off → Cancel.

Case 2 – New DP says no old DP available, number is unresponsive but calls connecting:
• Escalate the ticket.

Case 3 – Both DPs not responding to calls:
• Escalate the ticket.

items.title: Customer Address Mismatch
items.condition: DP cannot deliver due to incorrect address
items.details:
• Try to request the DP to deliver to the updated address or take the location on WhatsApp and get the order delivered.
• If DP is unable to connect with the customer but still needs assistance → Escalate to agent.
• If DP says distance is long → Select cancellation.
• Prompt: The delivery partner confirmed that the location is incorrect due to which he is unable to deliver the order.

items.title: Customer Unresponsive — DP at Location
items.condition: DP at delivery location, CX not answering calls
items.details:
• Prompt: The delivery partner has reached your location and is trying to connect with you. Kindly attend the call so that the order can be delivered.
• If DP says customer not responding to calls and he needs help → Escalate to agent.

items.title: Spillage / Damaged Order
items.condition: DP reports order is damaged or spilled
items.details:
• Check with the delivery partner.
• Minor damaged: Send prompt — As confirmed by the delivery partner, there is a minor spillage but the order can be handed over.
• Major / Fully damaged: Delay does not matter — Select cancellation.

items.title: Language Barrier
items.condition: Communication issue with DP due to language
items.details:
• Check with Smartplugs.
• If delay <30 mins → Send waiting prompt as per tracking and close the ticket.
• If delay >30 mins → Escalate.

items.title: Awaiting Pickup — Post-Transit Stuck
items.condition: Order stuck at awaiting pickup, DP & MX unreachable
items.details:
If DP & MX are unresponsive and unable to track order status (Status: Awaiting Pick Up):
• If delay >30 mins → Reassign. If not possible → Escalate to agent.

If MX is responsive and stating order is ready but DP is unresponsive (Status: Awaiting Pick Up):
• If delay <30 mins → Ask to wait.
• If delay >30 mins → Reassign. If not possible → Escalate to agent.

items.title: CX Asked DP to Cancel
items.condition: Customer requests cancellation directly to DP
items.details: • If CX asks DP to cancel the order → Escalate to the agent.

items.title: DP Marked Delivered but Didn't Hand Over Order
items.condition: DP updated status as delivered but order not given (damage/stolen)
items.details: • If DP says he has updated the status as delivered but didn't give order to customer since it is damaged / stolen → Escalate the ticket.

items.title: Partial Items Missing — CX Denied Order
items.condition: DP says partial items missing, customer refuses to accept
items.details: • If delivery partner says partial items are missing and customer denied to accept the order → Escalate the ticket.

items.title: DP Caught by Police (Post-Pickup)
items.condition: DP detained by police after picking up order
items.details: • If delay is more than 30 minutes and the DP says they are caught by the police and cannot deliver the order, and the order is already picked up → Cancel the order.

items.title: Post-Pickup DP Reassigned Case (PPC)
items.condition: Primary DP has initiated or completed reassignment
items.details:
1. If Primary DP confirms reassignment is already initiated and waiting for second DP:
   → Order status: "Arrival at CX Location"
   → Expected time: "10 mins + ETA" (if DP not yet assigned)

2. If Primary DP has reassigned and second DP details are visible, and second DP confirms on the way to collect from primary DP:
   → Expected time: "5 mins + ETA" (if time not confirmed)
   → If time confirmed → Mention exact as per DP's VOC.

3. In PPC:
   → No need to ask reason for delay (order already assigned to another DP with delay from previous).
   → Verify the delay through Smart Plug and mention accordingly.

items.title: Cancellation Scenarios
items.condition: When to select cancellation — all applicable scenarios
items.details:
Select Cancellation when:
• DP is unable to deliver the order (after trying to reassign first).
• MX is unable to cancel the order.
• MX is unable to prepare the order.
• Food is not ready and delay >40 mins (DP & MX unresponsive).
• Order is misplaced by DP (e.g., multi-order assignment).
• DP says customer asked to cancel order as it's a train order and train has left.

items.title: Private Note — Mandatory Rules
items.condition: PN must be filled on every ticket
items.details:
• If an agent wants to remove their assigned ticket, they must mention the reason in PN before assigning it to someone else.
• On each ticket it is mandatory to mention delay and tracking details in PN.

items.title: Grouped / Multi-Order Delay
items.condition: DP carrying multiple orders causing delay
items.details:
• If DP says they need support for another order from a different CX → Do NOT escalate. Ask them to contact DP Support for that specific order.
• Ask DP for delivery details of the specific order (order number). If DP provides the details → Give appropriate prompt. If not → Check Lifeline ETA.
• If DP not confirming time → Agents can add buffer time of 5 mins to ETA.
• If DP unresponsive → Add 5 mins to ETA.
• If DP informed waiting for second order delivery (CX getting change, not home, coming down, etc.) → Buffer time (5 mins) + ETA and add expected time.

Case 1 – DP at another restaurant:
• Prompt: The delivery partner is currently picking up another order from a different restaurant, which is causing a delay. Your order is being prioritized and will be delivered as soon as possible.

Case 2 – DP on another drop:
• Prompt: The delivery partner is currently completing another delivery and will reach your location shortly.
• Note: Compensation should be provided as per the delay.

If DP is on the way and not responding (delay <30 mins):
• Check the order series. If first order = assigned ticket's order → Give ETA.
• If second order = assigned ticket's order → ETA + 5 mins.

items.title: Order Status & Expected Time — Reference
items.condition: What status and time to set based on VOC
items.details:
MX VOC: Packing food / Preparing food / Giving food → Set Status: Preparation End

Arriving soon (order picked up, on way to deliver):
• Expected time: Less than 5 mins (if ETA not showing)

Reassigned case (order picked up by 1st DP):
• If DP says he is on the way to collect order from 2nd DP → Status: Arrival at CX Location
• Expected time: Pickup time + ETA

From 17-Apr-26 update (expected times):
• Post pick-up case: 10 mins (5 mins for search + 5 mins for pickup)
• Valet not assigned: 10 mins
• Food not ready: 10 mins
• Mall order (food waiting): 5 mins
• Multi-order case: 5 mins
• Arriving soon status: 5 mins
• DP waiting at restaurant, DP UR, MX confirmed food ready → Status: Arrival at Restaurant, Time: 5 mins

items.title: New Compensation Policy
items.condition: Delay-based compensation slabs (effective Apr 2026)
items.details:
• If delay is <30 mins → No compensation should be given.
• If delay is 30–45 minutes → 35% of OV (Min. ₹50, Max ₹100).
• If delay is 45+ minutes → 100% of OV (Max ₹500).
